purpose: Teach: 滞納/突発/陽性/観衆/空爆/同伴/中流/卓越

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、税の滞納問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on tax delinquency issues, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, slightly testing. Leans forward with genuine curiosity. Soft, patient rhythm. The tone of a teacher who's checking in, not checking up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、突発的な災害への備えを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on emergency preparedness for sudden disasters.
lines.style: Quiet and careful. Slight hesitation before the answer, as if double-checking his own thoughts. Even pacing, respectful. A little apologetic without saying so.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染症の陽性率の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on infection positivity rates in research, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Not quite a question — more like thinking out loud with him. Slow, measured delivery. Genuinely wondering if he'll correct her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代スポーツの観衆心理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually, I explored crowd psychology in modern sports.
lines.style: Gentle correction, no edge. Steady voice. The kind of quiet persistence that isn't defensive. Brief pause before the answer, gathering precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の空爆被害史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you tackled wartime air-raid damage history in your paper?
lines.style: More direct engagement now. Slightly raised energy. Leaning into the conversation like she's genuinely impressed. Clear, attentive delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、皇室の同伴行事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually researched imperial family attendance events.
lines.style: Still composed but with a trace of relief, like he's getting his actual work out there. Steady tempo. A tiny bit more grounded than the previous answer.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中流階級の社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, the sociology of the middle class — that was your focus, wasn't it?
lines.style: Knowing, almost gently amused. She's settled into a rhythm now, comfortable. Warm undertone. The pacing of someone genuinely enjoying a conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、卓越したリーダーの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my research actually examined outstanding leadership qualities.
lines.style: A small breath before starting. Quieter, with finality. As if he's come to the end of something. Steady but unhurried. Almost relieved to have spoken the truth.
